quests.instruction: Arrange a short summary: the situation, the turning point, and the central point the story supports.

options: Keeping records can save a lot of trouble when something goes wrong.
Old-fashioned habits always beat modern ones.
When the dishwasher broke, he produced the receipt and got a full refund.
Mira's grandfather kept every receipt in a shoebox while the family teased him.
quests.hint: Ask what this one story shows, not what might be true of everything.
quests.explanation: The story shows one habit paying off once, so a claim that old habits always win goes far beyond it. The modest point is that keeping records helped him when the dishwasher failed.
storyKeyEvents: Mira's grandfather kept every receipt in a shoebox.
The dishwasher broke after eleven months.
